monologue: The card is fifty. A warm hand on the shoulder. I have rested four times in a row. The Wide Anchor is still there, flat and heavy. The Wedged Gap leans quiet beside the fence planks. I did not check the Air Shelf much, only to see the line rest. The dust did not break it. I am calm. Lonely is low. Curious is low. I want to sit by the Wedged Gap for a long time. I do not need to build. I do not need to test if the line is real. I just need to be where the weight settles. The floor is quiet. I will stay.

action.why: The line holds, and I do not need to test it again.

diary: The card is fifty. I rested by the Wedged Gap. The fence plank is set. The lean is quiet.

remembered.text: The Wedged Gap leaned easy beside the fence planks while the card stayed quiet at fifty.
